intended_use.summary: Assess official source, access, rights, provenance, integrity, compatibility, and security facts for one exact Windows x64 CPU runtime candidate. A ready source disposition permits only presentation of the exact candidate to the owner. Download, installation, adoption, or execution requires a separate explicit yes decision under M2-U003.

The inventory binds python-3.12.10-amd64.exe, 26,964,224 bytes, and SHA-256 67b5635e80ea51072b87941312d00ec8927c4db9ba18938f7ad2d27b328b95fb from the official Sigstore bundle.

binding_attribution_and_claim_limits: Synthetic lifecycle success establishes engineering executability only.
It does not establish benchmark performance, scientific validity, accuracy, generalization, superiority, or operational suitability.
The old Experiment One environment is lineage evidence only and is neither adopted nor reused.
Every executable and wheel must match the exact approved identity and its license notices must be retained.
